System Network

Connectivity between chromatographic systems

Source: vignettes/network.qmd

Network Overview

The network shows how chromatographic systems are connected through pairwise models. Each node is a system and each edge a model between two systems (models are directional: one per source/target pair).

Metric Value
Total Systems (Nodes) 328
Total Models (Edges) 49,570
Average Models per System (as source) 151.1
Network Density 46.22%
